contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with corroborated FND-0103 (a priori h^0(L)\in{1,2,3,4} with the value 4 confined to hyperelliptic fibres by Clifford on the special degree-4 bundle M=ω_C^2\otimes W_5^vee), FND-0104 (which reduced GAP-H0-1 to whether a non-primitive g^1_4 can be F-balanced and explicitly did not settle that question), FND-0105 (GAP-Z-W5D localizes to the CE relative-canonical normalization), FND-0125 (hyperelliptic composed covers have F=O(2)\oplus O(7)), FND-0134 (uses h^0(L)=3 as input for reduced-support density), and FND-0135 (Castelnuovo–Severi plus primality of 2 names the factorization γ=q∘h). Independent primary checks. (1) Allowed CE types at (g,d)=(6,4): Canning–Larson, The Chow rings of the moduli spaces of curves of genus 7, 8, and 9, J. Algebraic Geom. 33 (2024), arXiv:2104.05820v2 §4.3, list exactly five smooth pairs; the unique hyperelliptic pair is Z: E=(1,4,4), F=(2,7), and the two F-balanced pairs are Ψ0: E=(3,3,3), F=(4,5) and Ψ1: E=(2,3,4), F=(4,5). Equation (4.5) of the same paper records e1=1 if and only if C is hyperelliptic, in which case the degree-4 map factors as q∘h; Lemma 4.5 identifies Z=β^{-1}(M_6^2). Thus no geometric fibre with F≅O(4)\oplus O(5) is hyperelliptic, so the Clifford-equality locus of FND-0103 is empty on the campaign's balanced locus and B_4=∅. This upgrades FND-0125's single-model computation to a complete published classification, so the incompatibility is rigid rather than example-dependent. (2) SRC-0004 Lemma 10.10 independently cuts the same locus: H_{4,6,n}^4 := {f1≥4}=H_{4,6,n}\β^{-1}(M_{6,n}^3∪PQ_n); for deg F=g+3=9 one has f1≤4, so f1≥4 means F=(4,5) and excludes every hyperelliptic fibre. (3) Constancy at 3 rather than the weaker bound h^0(L)≤3 uses L≅ω_C(-D). Casnati–Ekedahl, J. Algebraic Geom. 5 (1996), Thm. 2.1(1), restated as SRC-0005 Thm. 2.6(1) and used in the proof of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, gives O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C≅ω_α≅ω_C\otimesγ^*O(2). Combined with the packet convention W_5:=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)\otimesγ^*O(-5))|_C and the degree identity deg O(1)|_C=2g+6 of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, this forces W_5≅ω_C^2(-D) and L≅ω_C(-D), so h^0(L)=1+h^0(D). Always h^0(D)≥2 because γ^* is injective on H^0(P^1,O(1)); Clifford then gives h^0(D)≤3 with equality only in the now-empty hyperelliptic case. Hence h^0(L)=3 on every balanced geometric fibre, i.e. B=B_3. (4) Campaign consequences follow on this exact scope: GAP-H0-1 as carried by ATT-0066 and ATT-0089 is closed under fibrewise balancedness; every P^{k-1}-bundle or dim(Y)+k-1 clause with k=4 is vacuous; and pencil recovery |ω_C\otimes L^{-1}|=|D| is a g^1_4 on all of B. Mild scope note only: emptiness of B_4 uses only F-balancedness plus Clifford/CS/the CL type list, while the identification B=B_3 needs the CE relative-canonical line, which is now a cited source line rather than an unlabeled working-context fact. Distinct from FND-0125 (the unbalanced type itself) and from FND-0134 (Bertini reduced-support density, taking h^0(L)=3 as given): do not merge. Completes rather than contradicts FND-0104. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source. Merge target: none.
